description: The database describes individual water-well drilling reports, pump tests, springs, flowing shot holes and test holes, with chemical analyses only through the end of 1986. The saved metadata estimates about 500000 records and about 5000 newrecords annually; these are source estimates, not freshly enumerated counts. One Well_Reports ZIP descriptor is listed. Internal formats, field schema and actual archive access are unknown. The record represents the database, with no attempt to create individual well records. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above. Geographic coverage is Alberta; finer source-defined subdivisions are retained where stated.
